text:
beth: Quick sync — Q3 pricing/quota decision needed. Two options on the table: (A) soft overage + automated notifications + burst credits, (B) hard throttling by tier. Need launch criteria, MRR impact, billing UX, and rollout plan. Thoughts?

ravi: From runtime side, soft overage means queueing + fair-share + longer KV cache retention. Hard throttle is simpler. Soft is doable but likely +2 sprints.

sam: Finance prefers soft for retention, but we need a floor to avoid runaway spend. Suggest soft up to 10% over monthly commit then throttle. Need guardrails per-customer.

cleo: Ops: per-route quotas are being asked for by multiple customers. Implementation: route-level config with global fallback. Also require explicit flags for Dedicated customers (different billing).

beth: @ravi can you give a rough infra delta? @sam can you model revenue impact for soft vs hard? :thinking:

ravi: Ests: soft overage + burst credits -> ~+30% KV memory and +15% infra cost for peak headroom. Hard throttle -> minimal infra delta but higher support load and more error surface.

sam: Quick model: soft -> small increase in retention (~2% less churn) -> ~+3% ARR retention benefit. Hard throttle saves ~5% infra OPEX. We could introduce a small price uplift for soft-tier to offset cost.

alyssa: Legal: need explicit TOS language about overage handling and notification cadence. Also capture dispute resolution / refund policy for auto-billed overages. Nothing residency-specific here.

jo-support: Support: we need an automated notification pipeline (email + webhooks) + in-console indicators and a self-serve charge dispute flow. Also playbook for common escalations.

beth: Proposed launch criteria:
- runtime limit enforcement implemented + can be toggled per-customer
- notification pipeline + in-console UX for usage and warnings
- billing test harness + 1 end-to-end billing simulation
- SDK guidance for retry/backoff and example code
- 2 pilot customers (one platform team, one startup)
Agree?

ravi: :thumbsup: agree. Timeline: opt-in pilot in ~6 weeks, broad rollout at ~12 weeks if pilot OK. Will add infra runbook.

sam: Pricing experiment idea: two skus for same feature surface — "Pro (soft up to 10%)" and "Pro-Conservative (hard)". A/B these for new signups, track churn, infra cost, NPS.

cleo: Ops checklist: per-customer override knobs, alerts for sustained >10% overage, quota spike dashboards, SLO to auto-failover to cheaper model when budget threshold hit.

beth: Decision needed by EOW. Action items: @ravi upload infra estimate doc, @sam post revenue model, @alyssa draft TOS snippet, @jo-support sketch notification copy, I'll sync with sales for pilot candidates.

billing-bot: feature-flag created: quota-experiments/soft-overage (owner: beth).

beth: thanks all — will follow up with a short decision doc and a proposed OKR to track rollout metrics (pilot adoption, infra delta, churn delta, billing disputes). :eyes:
